TrailBlayzer hiking boots — Review
Back from a University Hiking Club outing where
I tested my new TrailBlayzer hiking boots.
They’re not too pretty, but they kept my feet
steady on the trail and dry in pouring rain.
I highly recommend the website too—the
TrailBlayzer chatbot and the order tracking
system were both great!
